api.name: Exchange
api.title: Exchange
api.description: The container that flows through a route: the current Message (the body and headers are on the message, not on the exchange), the exchange properties, the variables, the exception when a step failed, and the CamelContext. Camel 4 for code written against older Camel: getMessage() is the current message and getIn() its alias; getOut() is deprecated, set a reply on getMessage() instead; the exchange has no getHeader/setHeader, use exchange.getMessage().getHeader(name) and .setHeader(name, value); header names are plain strings such as "CamelFileName" (constants on Exchange or on the component's constants class).

getContext.description: The CamelContext: the registry, the type converter, the routes and the templates.

getException.description: The exception that failed the exchange, null when none. Inside onException the exception was moved to the property Exchange.EXCEPTION_CAUGHT and getException() is null.

getFromRouteId.description: The id of the route that created the exchange.

getIn.description: Alias of getMessage(): Camel 4 has one message on the exchange, not an in and an out.

getMessage.description: The current message: its body and headers are what a step reads and writes; the result of a step goes here. getIn() is an alias.

getPattern.description: InOnly or InOut: whether the caller waits for a reply (the body of getMessage() at the end of the route).

signatures: <T> T getProperty(String name, Object defaultValue, Class<T> type)
<T> T getProperty(ExchangePropertyKey key, Object defaultValue, Class<T> type)
getProperty.description: An exchange property: data Camel and the route keep for the whole routing next to the message (not sent to endpoints), e.g. Exchange.EXCEPTION_CAUGHT in an onException block, Exchange.AGGREGATED_SIZE after aggregate.

signatures: <T> T getVariable(String name, Object defaultValue, Class<T> type)
getVariable.description: A variable of this exchange (setVariable or the setVariable EIP); global:name reads a global variable, route:routeId:name a route's.

isFailed.description: Whether an exception is set on the exchange.

setException.description: Fails the exchange with the exception so the error handler takes over; setException(null) clears it. A Processor can also just throw.

setProperty.description: Sets an exchange property for the rest of the routing; removeProperty(name) removes it.

setVariable.description: Sets a variable on this exchange; global:name sets a global variable shared by all exchanges.
